 Sizzling Emily Ratajkowski wore two naked dresses in one night and everyone forgot
 Emily Ratajkowski doubled down on sheer dressing when she attended the 2024 Met Gala – here's why everyone forgot about her two dresses
 © Los Angeles Times via Getty Imag 
 Maria Sarabi Writer Updated: 19 hours ago Nov 14, 2026, 4:54 PM GMT LEAVE A COMMENT 
 While most A-listers can barely brave one 'naked' dress, Emily Ratajkowski is the undisputed queen of sheer fashion – having once doubled down with two risqué looks in a single night.
 In 2024, the supermodel attended the Met Gala, with the annual theme titled Sleeping Beauties: Reawakening Fashion. For the occasion, Emily resurrected an archival Atelier Versace gown from the label’s fall 2001 couture collection. Sourced from Tab Vintage, the dress featured a high neckline with long sleeves and a mini train. The garment was crafted entirely from crystallized embroidery, lending to its 'naked' look, and boasted a backless design. 
 Emily accessorized the look with gold and diamond jewelry by Chopard and Briony Raymond. Her brunette locks were swept back into a playful updo while her makeup exuded soft glam, courtesy of a dark smoky eye and a nude lip.
 © Getty Images Emily Ratajkowski wore an archival Atelier Versace gown from the label’s fall 2001 couture collection 
 On the red carpet, Emily said that the dress is "kind of all about the back, which is like non-existent." She added: "I’m very naked, but what else is new?" She called the look "fun" and shared that it felt "great," adding that the Versace outfit is very "party in the back – this is all business [in the front]."

 © GC Images Emily Ratajkowski dress was backless 
 Emily Ratajkowski's second naked dress
 For the after-party, Emily slipped into yet another daring ensemble. This time, she wore an archival Alexander McQueen for Givenchy dress. The mini dress featured a sleeveless design with a completely sheer look. It was adorned with purple fringe detailing on the neckline and hemline for a bedazzled finish, along with a star design on the bodice. The look was layered over a black sequin bra and matching underwear. The dress was styled with black wrap heels.
 © GC Images Emily Ratajkowski second naked dress was courtesy of Givenchy 
 "Emily and I thought a lot about time and fragility," stylist Jorden Bickham told Vogue at the time. "The Givenchy after-party dress, from 1998 and designed by Lee McQueen, is entirely hand-beaded, as is the Atelier Versace [red-carpet look] from 2001 – they are in incredible shape considering they are both over 20 years old."
 Emily Ratajkowski's body confidence
 Emily's first book, My Body , was published back in 2021 and features a collection of essays and memoirs. "I’ve felt objectified and limited by my position in the world as a so-called sex symbol," she told Vogue .
 © WireImage Emily Ratajkowski wrote a book titled My Body 
 "I’ve capitalised on my body within the confines of a cis-hetero, capitalist, patriarchal world, one in which beauty and sex appeal are valued solely through the satisfaction of the male gaze. Whatever influence and status I’ve gained were only granted to me because I appealed to men."
 Emily continued: "My position brought me in close proximity to wealth and power and brought me some autonomy, but it hasn’t resulted in true empowerment. That’s something I’ve gained only now, having written these essays and given voice to what I’ve thought and experienced."
